data.name: Ashabun
data.long_meaning: Ashabun is an Arabic name that means 'Friends of Prophet'. This name is derived from the term 'Ashab', which refers to the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who lived during his lifetime and supported him in his mission to spread Islam. This name is a beautiful reminder of the importance of friendship, love, and companionship in our lives, as well as the significance of following the teachings of the Prophet.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashabun is a spiritually significant name that symbolizes the connection between the individual and the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It is a reminder of the importance of companionship and following the teachings of the Prophet in order to lead a virtuous and fulfilling life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ashabun holds a great cultural significance for Muslims, as it is a tribute to the early supporters of Islam and their unwavering loyalty to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). These companions are regarded as role models for their sacrifice, courage, and devotion to the cause of Allah. Their stories of bravery, resilience, and unity in the face of adversity continue to inspire and unite Muslims across the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ashabun also holds deep spiritual significance as it underscores the importance of companionship with Allah and His Prophet, as well as with other believers. In the Quran, Allah says, "And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided" (3:103). By carrying the name Ashabun, one commits to embodying the principles of companionship and loyalty to Allah and His Messenger, and to striving for unity and solidarity in the Muslim Ummah. Ashabun also serves as a reminder of the importance of following the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and living a life of seemingly small yet impactful acts of kindness, generosity, and good character towards others.
